## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON (Growth/Momentum style). Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — confirmed by broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals/financials strength (JPM and CAT ABOVE TREND).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Discretionary lead: AMZN (1W: +16.49% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND and strong 1W confirmation; Technology lead: LRCX (1W: +21.42% | 1M: +28.37%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.60% | 1M: +39.41%) ABOVE TREND; Financials strong: JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.33%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Consumer Disc. positive (14 stocks), Technology positive (24 stocks), Financials positive (20 stocks).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: T (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND. Technology has laggards within a strong tape: INTU (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -16.37%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -22.73%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: LRCX (1W: +21.42% | 1M: +28.37%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.60% | 1M: +39.41%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +16.49% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +16.22% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +8.04%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — Growth/Momentum style.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -22.73%) BELOW TREND, OXY (1W: -12.01% | 1M: -4.32%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -16.37%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -2.54%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -9.58% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and selected high-multiple Tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: LRCX (1W: +21.42%), INTC (1W: +20.60%), AMZN (1W: +16.49%), ASML (1W: +16.22%), META (1W: +15.21%) — all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (MSFT RECOVERY, TSLA RECOVERY, WMT RECOVERY) — tactical caution: multiple large-cap names show 1W/1M mismatch, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech broadly strong with concentrated leadership: NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +9.02%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +5.59% | 1M: -0.62%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -16.37%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology positive (24 stocks); watch narrow top-heavy rally.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.33%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Financials positive (20 stocks); supports the RISK-ON case alongside Tech.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed but stable: UNH (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +11.38%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.59%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -6.35%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare positive (17 stocks); watch earnings-driven moves and regulatory headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Technology leaders showing strong 1W and 1M confirmation (LRCX, INTC, NVDA) while also favoring select Financials and Industrials (JPM, CAT) to capture broadening participation; reduce exposure to Energy names showing clear weakness (XOM, CVX). Monitor the major divergence across several large caps (MSFT, TSLA, WMT) before committing size increases.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: LRCX (1W: +21.42% | 1M: +28.37%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.60% | 1M: +39.41%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +16.49% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -22.73%) BELOW TREND — watch for continued outflows.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (positive breadth, narrow leadership) and Financials (positive breadth). BEARISH: Energy (Sector Weakness) and Communications (lagging); breadth: Energy negative, Communication negative.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Monitor weekly follow-through in LRCX and INTC to confirm breakout continuation; NVDA needs to hold recent 1W gains to keep ABOVE TREND momentum; XOM failure to reclaim short-term levels would reinforce Energy BELOW TREND and widen sector underperformance. Watch MSFT for confirmation of RECOVERY vs. reversal if 1M weakness resumes.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
AVGO (+60): Broadcom/Meta AI partnership headline; AVGO (1W: +14.02% | 1M: +18.44%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. JNJ (+60): earnings beat/dividend lift; JNJ (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.59%) RECOVERY — sentiment supported but 1M still soft. MPC (+60): upgraded views/buybacks; MPC (1W: -8.76% | 1M: -0.99%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price not confirming (divergence).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
SHW (-60): downgrade/insider sales flagged — where price data exists watch for downside follow-through (price not in this brief). WBD (-55): deal/regulatory concerns pressuring sentiment; watch communication names for flow impact. VLO (-50): refinery blast headline — Energy already BELOW TREND (XOM (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND), so sentiment confirms sector weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON (Growth/Momentum style); Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.42% | 1M: +28.37%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.60% | 1M: +39.41%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.49% | 1M: +19.91%). Key risk: major divergence across large caps (MSFT RECOVERY, TSLA RECOVERY, WMT RECOVERY) and clear Energy weakness (XOM BELOW TREND) — monitor sentiment-confirmation for entries.
